ceu: ✦ The square between the Moon and Jupiter at {H:1825107730000}

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Teach someone something you know well.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Review debts, loans or shared accounts calmly.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between relationships and family. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between routine and conversations. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Take a real lunch break, without screens.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between romance and money. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between family and your image. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between money and friendships. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between your image and your career. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
The square between the Moon and Jupiter creates some tension between your career and relationships. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.
